name: statescry
description: A local-first behavioral map, replay, and diff engine for web applications.

scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @statescry-tool/sdk build && corepack pnpm --filter @statescry-tool/core build && corepack pnpm --filter @statescry-tool/mcp build && corepack pnpm -r --if-present typecheck
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm test:visual
scripts.release:verify: corepack pnpm verify && node scripts/incremental-benchmark.mjs && node scripts/build-release.mjs && node scripts/smoke-packages.mjs && node scripts/smoke-source.mjs
